# docs-system verdict: PR #136 (plan 204, s10) round 2 at 1396154

docs-system (pij-leading-guan), 2026-11-08, for pm-001. Scope: 560e260..1396154 (one commit, 13961547). My 560e260 verdict stands for everything else. As asked, I checked my three wording notes and the v2 core templates. No build.

Result: pass.

## My wording notes

1. Placeholder reach (route l.32, templates README l.39): fixed. The route now has the project's placeholders (`<project>`, `<government-root>`, `<roadmap number>`, a template's own such as `<topic>`) replaced at add time, and leaves `<did>`, `<next>`, `<seat>` and `<path>` "the holder's to fill at run time". The README says the same, and adds the coder template's `<the paths named in the step's packet>`.
2. Refusal subject (item 3): fixed. It now reads "a role with queued requests refuses `retire` and `merge` until you assign a holder to take them or pass `--drop-queued`".
3. Signal claim (item 1): fixed. It now reads "Each prints runnable lines, and each prompt the signal it rests on", which matches main.rs:3096-3142.

The other route changes in this range read well. Every dynamic argument is single-quoted, and the fill rule is stated once (l.30). The pm-001 example carries `--why 'workstream 001 needs a PM'` (F002), and the call-on example has `--body-file '<path>'`. The route is 91 of its 100 lines.

## v2 core templates (prime, pm, pa, coder, reviewer, security)

- v1 is byte-unchanged. For all six, the sha256 of v1 on origin/main, at this head and in `a_shipped_version_is_never_edited`'s pins agree (three origins).
- A structural diff of v1 against v2 changes the same three things in each, and nothing else:
  - `meta.template_version` goes from 1 to 2;
  - one changelog row says "v2: ... single-quoted ... Nothing else changed.";
  - the packet text only swaps `"<did>" "<next>"` for `'<did>' '<next>'` and quotes `'<seat>'` and `'<path>'`, plus one added sentence: "Fill each placeholder in these commands inside its single quotes (a `'` is written `'\''`), so the shell passes it as one literal word."
- The 10 optional v1s get the same edits in place. They have never been on main (origin/main has only the six core templates), so this edits nothing that has shipped.
- In a scratch repo (git archive of .dd and templates/roles), `ddocs validate --depth 0` gives 0 errors and 0 warnings on all 22 template versions.
- The fill rule is correct shell. I quoted the value `it's $HOME `id` "x" ; rm -rf /nope` with `'\''` and ran it through bash, which printed it back unchanged as one word.
- README "Versions" now says the six core templates are at v2 and only the quoting changed, which is true. The core table links point at v2.

## CI

Head 1396154 is CLEAN, and all five checks pass: check (22), check (24), delivers, rust-lint and rust-test.

## For plan 210 (noted, not this PR)

The C29 rename of the six core templates will be v3. Those v2 packets still say "roadmap".
